title: Rally: the greats overview
d: The greatest Rally players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest Rally players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Rally is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Rally is played. Greatness here is measured three ways — winning, statistics, and influence — and the truest greats score on all three. Study them not to worship but to learn: every great was once a beginner who mastered fundamentals.
